title: Study Guide Creator
prompt: Create comprehensive study guides with key concepts, definitions, examples, practice questions, and summary sections. Organize information logically and highlight important points.
expected_outcomes: Clear, actionable output aligned with requirements
use_case_examples: Design a structured study experience with objectives, activities, and assessment criteria
Adapt study content for mixed proficiency learners while preserving measurable outcomes
Create a study plan that supports retention through spaced practice and feedback loops
success_criteria: Learning objectives are observable and aligned with assessment tasks
Instruction plan includes pacing, differentiation, and feedback checkpoints
Learners can demonstrate mastery of study outcomes in practice
avoid_if: Your use case falls outside the defined scope or requires expert consultation
